relevance_note: A pediatric Behcet's cohort in which WES found TNFAIP3 variants in three probands (P6, P7, P8), described individually in Tables 1 and 2: 'haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20; three cases)'.
method_note: Hand-transcribed from Tables 1 and 2 and the Figure 3 legend; no script transcription of tables. Scope: the three TNFAIP3 probands (P6, P7, P8) and the two carrier fathers named in Table 1's 'Gene mutation' cells ('TNFAIP3 (father)' for P6 and P8); the 31 other cohort members (RELA, GATA2, trisomy 8, ped-BD) get no rows; cohort_size_as_stated = 34. Variant descriptions are only in Figure 1 (not in the text), so variant_original_string is 'not reported' for all rows. Pathogenicity left not reported: the only statement is 'pathogenic or likely pathogenic' for the group of nine probands (two values). Variant type and zygosity left not reported: the Discussion says all variants 'are predicted to result in frameshift or truncation' (several values, group-level) and does not state zygosity per person. P7: Table 1 and the Results say 'de novo', but the paper does not describe testing both parents, so inheritance is 'not reported' under rule 8; the statement is kept in parental_testing_statement. P6 and P8: inherited paternal from 'TNFAIP3 (father)' plus the Results sentence on two HA20 cases with parentally inherited variants. Fathers' sex recorded as male from the word 'father'; nothing else is reported about them (affected status unknown). Ages in Table 1 are in years per the column headers (header quoted as a second span). Age at diagnosis 23 (P6) and 21 (P8) in a 'pediatric' cohort is as printed. Vital status 'alive' from the Survival column 'Yes'. Table 1 'fever' was recorded as the checklist item 'recurrent fever' (the Results describe 'recurrent fever episodes (7/10...)' and 7 SAID+ patients have fever in Table 1, but the table cell itself only says 'fever'). P6 vasculitis is a histological finding in the oral ulcer described as 'consistent with vasculitis'. Group-level counts (Table 3, e.g. 'Neurological manifestations (n) | 0', 'Vascular signs (n) | 0', 'ANA positive | 7') and the HA20 n=3 medians in Supplemental Table 1 (CRP, ESR, cytokines) were not assigned to individuals; zero counts exclude no one; study exclusion criteria (positive autoantibodies) were not used. No stacked ' / ' cells occur in per-patient tables. Contradiction: the Results say fever was an initial presenting symptom in 2 SAID+ patients ('fever (n = 2)'), while Table 1 lists Fever as initial symptom only for P7. Also 'nine kindreds' for 10 probands (P3 is P2's daughter, RELA family, out of scope).
